detail: R-0.1 (Bounded Small-Task Fast Path) contract approved as drafted via AskUserQuestion. Moved PLANNED -> READY. R-0.1/WP-1 (small-task classification and routing design) complete. classification-design.md defines 5 deterministic signals for fast-path eligibility (declared scope <=2 named files, add/modify only - excludes delete/rename by definition, no renmark/**/plugin/** target, no cross-file dependency reusing dispatch.validate_wave, single deterministic verifier) and the routing rule (pure function, no model call to classify, one-line justification per decision). Reuses existing primitives rather than reinventing: dispatch.validate_wave's context-files check, Task.complexity as an optional accelerant, the deterministic-first gate's shape applied at request-routing time. Interfaces explicitly with WP-2 (declared scope becomes WP-2's enforcement input) and WP-3 (regression suite must assert non-fast-path routing is unchanged). One open question flagged for later, not resolved: renmark/**/plugin/** targets excluded from fast path entirely as a conservative first-cut default. Zero renmark/** changes - docs-only design deliverable.

R-0.1/WP-2 (Worker scope-enforcement design) complete, the direct answer to R-0.0's Scenario C finding (F2). Grounded in actual current code (renmark/providers/claude_agent.py::build_agent_dispatch's scope is one prose sentence, never checked; SubagentOutput.touched_files is self-reported and never cross-checked). Design: Layer A (host permission prompt, pre-existing, confirmed as what actually blocked Scenario C, out of Renmark's scope to change) + Layer B (new, verify_worker_scope() - deterministic, compares declared WorkerScope.allowed_paths/allowed_actions against real git diff --name-status, never against self-report; delete/rename always a violation on fast path; out-of-scope path always a violation). FAIL blocks merge, no auto-revert, escalates, ledger-recorded. Specifies the literal Scenario C reproduction as a required WP-4 regression test. No-nested-dispatch honestly flagged as partially unresolved (no host-independent signal exists today), not overclaimed. Wrote ADR-002 (decisions/ADR-002-worker-scope-enforcement.md), added to decisions/INDEX.md. Zero renmark/** changes.
